from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CitationEntry(BaseModel):
    """One paper in the collection: its title and its citation relationships with other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's full title")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")
    cited_by: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper (determined from their reference lists)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[CitationEntry]
